00394328877b.name: Battle Codifier
00394328877b.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, each KASTELAN ROBOTS unit in a Detachment lets you include a CYBERNETICA DATASMITH unit in that Detachment without it using up an additional Battlefield Role slot.

02518d23fc19.name: Supervisory Radiance
02518d23fc19.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, pick one of your <FORGE WORLD> CULT MECHANICUS CORE units within 9" of this WARLORD to re-roll its melee hit rolls. This lasts until the start of the next Fight phase: you can re-roll the hit roll for each melee attack a model in that unit makes.

043e2cca77fc.name: Cacophonous Leadership (Aura)
043e2cca77fc.plain: Aura: your MECHANICUS DEFENCE COHORT units within 6" of this WARLORD have the Objective Secured ability. While they are in range, each EXTREMIS SENTINEL model in such a unit counts as one extra model when working out who controls an objective marker.

04ced6aba3d6.name: Stratagem: Expedited Purge Protocols - 1 CP/2 CP
04ced6aba3d6.plain: One of your SKITARII VETERAN COHORT CORE units (excluding VEHICLE models) that Advances in your Movement phase can still declare a charge this turn. Use it when that unit Advances. It costs 1 CP if the unit is a SKITARII RANGER or SKITARII VANGUARD unit, and 2 CP otherwise. This is a Strategic Ploy Stratagem.

04d14187cede.name: Self-repair Mechanisms
04d14187cede.plain: This model can repair itself in your Command phase, regaining up to D3 lost wounds when it does. A model can be repaired only once per turn.

04da68cb57c9.name: Transuranic Arquebus
04da68cb57c9.plain: When picking this weapon's target, the Look Out, Sir rule can be ignored. An unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon inflicts 1 mortal wound as well as its normal damage.

0779ce43c322.name: Radium Pistol
0779ce43c322.plain: A hit roll of 6 with this weapon automatically wounds the target, as long as the target is an enemy unit that is not a VEHICLE unit.

0792093bc1e6.name: Stratagem: Purity of the Machine - 1 CP/2 CP
0792093bc1e6.plain: One of your METALICA units can ignore hit and wound roll modifiers when it shoots in your Shooting phase or fights in the Fight phase. Use it when that unit is selected to shoot or to fight. Until the end of that phase, its models' attacks can ignore any or all modifiers to their hit rolls and wound rolls. It costs 2 CP if the unit is a VEHICLE, and 1 CP otherwise.

07cfdbe44c07.name: Kyropatris Field
07cfdbe44c07.plain: Models in this unit each have a 5+ invulnerable save.

0813d8af3716.name: Cartogrammatist
0813d8af3716.plain: When you choose this Warlord Trait, one <FORGE WORLD> CULT MECHANICUS CORE unit from your army gains an ability to deploy in orbit and arrive later. Pick that unit; it gains this ability: during deployment, you can set it up in orbit rather than on the battlefield. If you do, then in the Reinforcement step of one of your Movement phases, you can set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from enemy models.

085308233556.name: Luminary Suffusion
085308233556.plain: Models with this dogma swap Rad-saturation for an aura taking 1 off the Strength and Toughness of non-VEHICLE enemy units within 3". The new ability is Extreme Rad-saturation (Aura): while an enemy unit (other than a VEHICLE unit) is within 3" of this unit, that enemy unit's models have 1 subtracted from their Strength and Toughness characteristics.

09793e9dda8c.name: Chain-taser Protocols
09793e9dda8c.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units is picked to fight: for the rest of the phase, whenever a model in it attacks with a taser weapon, an unmodified 5 to hit gives 2 extra hits.

09cbbe3bba14.name: Servo-skull Uplink (Aura)
09cbbe3bba14.plain: Aura: while one of your <FORGE WORLD> SKITARII CORE units is within 6" of this model, models in that unit re-roll wound rolls of 1 when making attacks.

0b225dc8bd75.name: Combined Landing
0b225dc8bd75.plain: If a Detachment has more than one ARCHAEOPTER TRANSVECTOR model, you can have pairs of them make combined landings rather than setting them up on the battlefield. For each combined landing, pick two <FORGE WORLD> ARCHAEOPTER TRANSVECTOR models. When deciding which units can embark in them, the two TRANSPORT models count as a single model whose combined transport capacity is 12 <FORGE WORLD> INFANTRY models. So an eligible INFANTRY unit of 7 to 12 models can begin the battle inside the pair, with its INFANTRY models split across the two transports; write down which INFANTRY models are in which TRANSPORT model. Whatever the mission rules say, the pair can arrive during the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, and both must be placed at the same time. Units embarked in them must disembark straight after the TRANSPORT models are placed, and those units have to be placed more than 9" from enemy models. When the pair is placed, the two TRANSPORT models must be within 9" of each other, and disembarking units must follow the usual rules for disembarking from transports and for unit coherency.

0bd9f44a3cd7.name: Strafing Fire Run
0bd9f44a3cd7.plain: When your Movement phase starts, choose a CYBERNETICA COHORT KASTELAN ROBOTS unit of yours with its Aegis Protocol active. For the rest of the turn, its Heavy weapons are treated as Assault weapons for all rules purposes.

0ccd711284c9.name: Fleeting Barrage
0ccd711284c9.plain: Falling Back doesn't stop this unit from being eligible to shoot that turn.

0d9a22916377.name: Steel Mind, Iron Logic
0d9a22916377.plain: During your opponent's Psychic phase, if an enemy PSYKER tries to manifest a psychic power within 18" of any GRAIA unit from your army, roll one D6; a 4+ denies that power.

0da2cadb93aa.name: Legio Teleportarium
0da2cadb93aa.plain: Before the battle, in the Declare Reserves and Transports step (or during deployment, if your mission has no such step), pick one of your LUCIUS units (not a VEHICLE unit). You can place it in a teleportarium rather than setting it up on the battlefield. If you do, you can set it up in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases, anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from all enemy models. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

0df6df795018.name: Firepoint Telemetry Cache

0e0698a420d5.name: Booster Thrust
0e0698a420d5.plain: At the end of your turn, pick one of your PTERAXII units that wasn't set up on the battlefield this turn and take it off the battlefield. Then, during the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, you may put it back anywhere on the battlefield that is over 9" from every enemy model. A unit still off the battlefield when the battle ends is destroyed.

0f79d1f4b852.name: Doctrina Imperatives
0f79d1f4b852.plain: Protector Imperative gives +1 BS and -1 WS. Conqueror Imperative gives +1 WS and -1 BS. Bulwark Imperative gives +1 to the Save characteristic (it can't go better than 2+) and -3" to the Move characteristic. Aggressor Imperative gives +3" to the Move characteristic and -1 to the Save characteristic.

108cbe576a8f.name: Engineered Nanophages
108cbe576a8f.plain: Melee attacks by models with this dogma improve their Armour Penetration by 1 when allocated to a model whose Save characteristic is 3+ or better.

10e8cebe6907.name: Mag-inverter Shield
10e8cebe6907.plain: Against melee attacks, this model has a 4+ invulnerable save. Each time you roll an unmodified 6 on an invulnerable saving throw for the bearer against a melee attack, the attacking model's unit suffers 1 mortal wound once that unit has finished making all its attacks.

10f1d7d12f5a.name: Parent Protocols
10f1d7d12f5a.plain:
Use the dogma of one Forge World you pick from Agripinaa, Graia, Lucius, Mars, Metalica, Ryza and Stygies VIII; this primary dogma has no secondary dogmas.
A CHARACTER model with this dogma that gains a Warlord Trait can take the Warlord Trait of the Forge World you picked, instead of one of the standard Warlord Traits. If it does, swap every instance of the <FORGE WORLD> keyword on that Warlord Trait, if there are any, for the name of the Forge World the CHARACTER is from.
You also get that Forge World's Stratagems, unless every unit with this dogma is part of an Auxiliary Support, Super-Heavy Auxiliary and/or Fortification Network Detachment.

waive.66: page number in a book reference ('a Warlord trait from pages 66-67'); page references are left out per STYLE rule 6
waive.67: page number in a book reference ('a Warlord trait from pages 66-67'); page references are left out per STYLE rule 6

12cef33998a0.name: Expedited Purge Protocol
12cef33998a0.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your SKITARII VETERAN COHORT CORE units (not a VEHICLE unit) Advances: that unit can still declare a charge this turn even though it Advanced. This Stratagem costs 1CP if the unit is a SKITARII RANGERS or SKITARII VANGUARD unit, and 2CP otherwise.

13412c718fb8.name: Acquisition at Any Cost
13412c718fb8.plain: At the start of the Morale phase, pick one objective marker on the battlefield. Until the end of that phase, any ADEPTUS MECHANICUS unit from your army that is wholly within 6" of that marker automatically passes Morale tests.

15ce977a987e.name: Luminescent Blessings
15ce977a987e.plain: In your Command phase, pick one LUCIUS CORE unit within 9" of this WARLORD; attacks against it fail to wound on an unmodified wound roll of 1-3. This lasts until the start of your next Command phase, and applies whatever abilities the attacking weapon or model has.

16a975d97f1d.name: Clawed Limbs
16a975d97f1d.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it makes 2 extra attacks with this weapon.

16cff199d22f.name: Radium Carbine
16cff199d22f.plain: A hit roll of 6+ with this weapon automatically wounds the target, as long as the target is an enemy unit that is not a VEHICLE unit.

16f2a5a76fb4.name: Noospheric Mindlock
16f2a5a76fb4.plain: When your Shooting phase starts, choose a SERVITOR MANIPLE KATAPHRON BREACHERS unit or SERVITOR MANIPLE KATAPHRON DESTROYERS unit within 6" of a friendly SERVITOR MANIPLE TECH-PRIEST DOMINUS. For the rest of the phase, that unit's attacks get 1 added to their hit rolls.

16f924de95d0.name: Clandestine Infiltration
16f924de95d0.plain: During deployment, pick one of your STYGIES VIII CORE INFANTRY units. When you set it up, you can place it anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from the enemy deployment zone and from all enemy models.

180e7c632af8.name: Benevolence of the Omnissiah
180e7c632af8.plain: Use in any phase when a mortal wound is about to make one of your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE models lose a wound. For the rest of that phase, roll one D6 whenever a mortal wound would make that model lose a wound; on a 4+ it keeps that wound.

18fb2886c45a.name: Bionic Endurance
18fb2886c45a.plain: In any phase, when a model in one of your SKITARII VETERAN COHORT CORE units would lose a wound: until the end of the phase, roll one D6 each time a model in that unit would lose a wound. On a 5+, the wound is not lost. This Stratagem costs 3CP if that unit's Power Rating is 10 or more, and 2CP otherwise.

192025379925.name: Arc Grenades
192025379925.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS ARC GRENADES units is selected to shoot, pick one enemy VEHICLE unit within 6" of it and roll one D6. On a 2 to 5, that VEHICLE unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, it suffers 2D3 mortal wounds.

1952094d1c7f.name: Incense Exhausts
1952094d1c7f.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when one of your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS SMOKESCREEN units is chosen as an attack's target: for the rest of that phase, attacks made against that unit subtract 1 from their hit rolls.

19c1fc78ed1f.name: Lord of the Machine Cult (Aura)
19c1fc78ed1f.plain: Aura: while one of your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS CORE units is within 6" of this model, models in that unit re-roll hit rolls of 1 when making attacks.

19f75a98890e.name: Manoeuvrable Craft
19f75a98890e.plain: Whenever this model makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, first turn it on the spot by up to 90° (this doesn't count toward the distance it moves), then move it straight forward. At any point during that move it can turn by up to 90° once more.

1afa0d904c8a.name: Stratagem: March To War - 1 CP
1afa0d904c8a.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your METALICA units Advances, skip its Advance roll and add 6" to its Move characteristic until the end of the phase.

1e0322267f7e.name: Omnitrac Impellors
1e0322267f7e.plain: KATAPHRON SERVITORS and ONAGER DUNECRAWLER models with this dogma have 2" added to their Move characteristic.

1ef7a3f3f9a0.name: Electro-filament Countermeasures
1ef7a3f3f9a0.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, choose one of your ARCHAEOPTER models that has a command uplink, then choose one enemy unit within 6" of it. Aura abilities of other enemy units don't affect that enemy unit until your next Movement phase starts.

2022036192ad.name: Legendary Fighter
2022036192ad.plain: If this Warlord makes a charge in the Charge phase, its Attacks characteristic goes up by 1 until the end of the Fight phase that follows.

20d8acd22832.name: Machine Superiority
20d8acd22832.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your SKITARII units is selected to fight: until the end of the phase, models in that unit add 1 to their Strength characteristic.

214bc6fb40e4.name: Order in Anarchy
214bc6fb40e4.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your METALICA units. Until the end of the turn, when a model in that unit makes an attack that targets an enemy unit within 12", you can add 1 to that hit roll.

256fc91a093d.name: Radiant Disciples
256fc91a093d.plain: Ranged attacks that target a CORE unit with this dogma from more than 12" away have their Strength characteristic reduced by 1.

25acd065b88e.name: Battle-Sphere Uplink

2600cf04915c.name: Infoslave Skull
2600cf04915c.plain: At the end of the Reinforcements step in your opponent's Movement phase, choose one of your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS CORE units that is not in Engagement Range of any enemy units. That unit may shoot now as though it were your Shooting phase. When it does, its models may only shoot at one single eligible enemy unit within 12" of their unit that was set up as Reinforcements this turn.

29d5c8fd539f.name: Battle Protocols: Aegis
29d5c8fd539f.plain: While this protocol is active, this unit's models have a Sv characteristic of 2+.

2d0cdbbe1610.name: Broad Spectrum Data-tether
2d0cdbbe1610.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <FORGE WORLD> SKITARII CORE units within 6" of this unit. Until your next Command phase starts, that unit gains the DATA-TETHER keyword and its models get 1 added to their Leadership characteristic.

2db78737e64b.name: Ashrunner
2db78737e64b.plain: This WARLORD has 3" added to its Move characteristic, and 1 added to each of its Strength and Attacks characteristics.

2e35b6655a7d.name: Tactica Obliqua
2e35b6655a7d.plain: In your opponent's Charge phase, when an enemy unit picks one of your SERBERYS RAIDERS units as a charge target: as long as your unit is outside Engagement Range of all enemy units, it may make a Normal Move. For the rest of the phase it can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend. Your opponent may then choose new targets for that charge.

2e40fb091d9c.name: Arc Pistol
2e40fb091d9c.plain: When this weapon attacks a VEHICLE unit, the attack has Damage 2, and an unmodified wound roll of 4 wounds it successfully.

2e496b7f6b06.name: Stratagem: Bionic Endurance - 2 CP/3 CP
2e496b7f6b06.plain: One of your SKITARII VETERAN COHORT CORE units can ignore lost wounds on a 5+ until the end of the phase. Use it in any phase, when a model in that unit would lose a wound. Until the end of the phase, whenever a model in the unit would suffer a wound, roll one D6: on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound. It costs 3 CP if the unit's Power Rating is 10 or more, and 2 CP otherwise. This is a Strategic Ploy Stratagem.

2e81644dbcd0.name: Grav gun
2e81644dbcd0.plain: When this weapon's target has a Save characteristic of 3+ or better, the weapon's Damage characteristic becomes D3.

30b0a7b1945b.name: Host of the Intermediary
30b0a7b1945b.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the ADEPTUS MECHANICUS keyword: pick one SKITARII model in your army that has 'Alpha' or 'Princeps' in its profile, and give it one Skitarii Warlord Trait (chosen or rolled). That model counts as your WARLORD only for that Warlord Trait. All Warlord Traits in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if you roll them randomly), and this Stratagem can't give one model two Warlord Traits. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

33ab12817aa3.name: Tribute of Emphatic Veneration
33ab12817aa3.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, pick one enemy unit within 12" of this WARLORD to subtract 1 from its hit rolls. This lasts until the start of your next Command phase and applies to every attack a model in that unit makes.

33d00b263103.name: Magnabond Alloys
33d00b263103.plain: Whenever a VEHICLE model with this dogma is about to lose a wound, roll one D6; on a 6, the wound is not lost.

33e4a192618e.name: Blaring Glory
33e4a192618e.plain: In the Fight phase or in your opponent's Shooting phase, pick one enemy unit within 6" of one of your METALICA units. Until the end of the phase, your opponent can't re-roll any dice rolls for attacks made by models in that enemy unit.

39599fea0ff2.name: Swooping Strikes
39599fea0ff2.plain: Each time this unit fights having made a charge move or having been charged, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its models until that fight is resolved.

39774bb46bdd.name: Rad-saturation (Aura)
39774bb46bdd.plain: Aura: the models of any enemy unit (other than a VEHICLE unit) within Engagement Range of this unit have 1 subtracted from their Strength and Toughness characteristics.

39783445e9d0.name: Adaptive Mastery
39783445e9d0.plain: Once per battle, when you use an Adeptus Mechanicus Battle Tactic Stratagem while this model is on the battlefield, that Stratagem costs 1 CP less. The discount applies only to that single use; any later use of the Stratagem costs its usual CP.

39c8ad36483e.name: Lord of the Machine Cult (Aura)
39c8ad36483e.plain: Aura: while one of your <FORGE WORLD> CORE units is within 6" of this model, models in that unit re-roll hit rolls of 1 when making attacks.

3c3bb244bc86.name: Omni-Scrambler
3c3bb244bc86.plain: When enemy units are set up on the battlefield as Reinforcements, they can't be placed within 12" of this unit.

3cb002cf6a59.name: Arc Scourge
3cb002cf6a59.plain: When this weapon attacks a VEHICLE unit, the attack has Damage 2 and successfully wounds on any unmodified wound roll of 2+.

3e0e9ae00ff8.name: Stratagem: Rad-Bombardment - 3 CP
3e0e9ae00ff8.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, place a marker that can deal mortal wounds to every unit within 6" of it when your next Command phase begins. You need a MECHANICUS DEFENCE COHORT WARLORD from your army on the battlefield to do this. Put the marker on any point of the battlefield. When your next Command phase begins, roll one D6 for every unit within 6" of the marker's centre, subtracting 1 from the roll for a CHARACTER unit. On a 4-5, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. On a 6+, it suffers D3 mortal wounds and each of its models has its Toughness characteristic reduced by 1 until the turn ends (this is not cumulative). Then remove the marker.

3f47b6b3c5ca.name: Daedalus Missile Launcher
3f47b6b3c5ca.plain: When this weapon profile is used to attack an AIRCRAFT unit, add 1 to the attack's hit roll.

3f8ca09a8b01.name: Stratagem: Blaring Glory - 1 CP
3f8ca09a8b01.plain: In the Fight phase or your opponent's Shooting phase, stop one enemy unit within 6" of one of your METALICA units from re-rolling dice for its attacks. Pick that enemy unit; until the end of the phase, your opponent can't re-roll any dice rolls made for attacks by models in it.

3ff93bce5279.name: Veiled Hunter
3ff93bce5279.plain: When the first battle round starts, you can redeploy up to two of your STYGIES VIII units that are wholly within your deployment zone. Take those units off the battlefield and set them up again anywhere wholly inside your deployment zone. If the mission has the Strategic Reserves rule, you can put any of them into Strategic Reserves instead, at no extra CP cost and however many units are already there. If both players have redeploy abilities, roll off; the winner decides which player redeploys their units first.

407f097c7fef.name: Rugged Explorators
407f097c7fef.plain:
Models in this unit fire Heavy weapons after moving without the hit penalty, and its VEHICLE models do the same with Assault weapons after Advancing.
- Models in this unit don't take the hit roll penalty for firing Heavy weapons in a turn in which their unit moved.
- VEHICLE models in this unit don't take the hit roll penalty for firing Assault weapons in a turn in which their unit Advanced.

413228430dc7.name: Arc Lance (melee)
413228430dc7.plain: Attacks made with this weapon against a VEHICLE unit have a Damage characteristic of D3.

414ef1e4d601.name: Battle Protocols: Protector
414ef1e4d601.plain: While this protocol is active, this unit can't move except to pile in or consolidate, and its models have a BS characteristic of 3+.

44087b4a74ac.name: Servo-focused auguries
44087b4a74ac.plain: Models with this dogma can re-roll hit rolls for ranged attacks made with cognis weapons against targets within half range.

4498e2fd7fa2.name: Masterwork Bionics
4498e2fd7fa2.plain: This WARLORD gets a 4+ invulnerable save, and every attack allocated to it has its Damage characteristic reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

44cd042bc615.name: Knight of the Iron Cog
44cd042bc615.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, pick one of your HOUSE RAVEN units. It gains the Canticles of the Omnissiah ability and counts as having the ADEPTUS MECHANICUS keyword for that ability. Including this unit doesn't stop ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units in your army from using rules that need every model in your army to have the ADEPTUS MECHANICUS keyword.

4522197a86ca.name: Neurostatic Interference
4522197a86ca.plain: When an attack is made against this unit by an attacking model within 12", neither the hit roll nor the wound roll can be re-rolled.

456065cc13d2.name: Lord of Mars
456065cc13d2.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your MARS CORE units within 6" of this model. Models in that unit can re-roll their hit rolls when they attack, until your next Command phase starts.

45a741d28079.name: Mantra of Discipline

45f3a4d1005f.name: Mindlock
45f3a4d1005f.plain: While this unit is within 6" of any of your <FORGE WORLD> TECH-PRIEST units, its models have Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of 4+ and a Leadership characteristic of 9. Also, if your army is Battle-forged, each <FORGE WORLD> TECH-PRIEST unit in a Detachment lets you include one <FORGE WORLD> SERVITORS unit in that Detachment without it using up a Battlefield Role slot.

483674cbe8ff.name: Rad-oversaturation
483674cbe8ff.plain: When any phase starts, choose one METALICA SKITARII VANGUARD unit in your army. For the rest of that phase, its Rad-saturation ability reaches out to 6".

4c4e465806d4.name: Extinction Order
4c4e465806d4.plain: In your Shooting phase, pick one Area Terrain feature that your METALICA WARLORD can see. Until the end of the phase, when a model in one of your METALICA units that is within 6" of your METALICA WARLORD makes an attack targeting an enemy unit wholly within that feature, add 1 to that attack's wound roll.

4c723515037b.name: Stratagem: Citation of Ruin - 2 CP/3 CP
4c723515037b.plain: In your Shooting phase, one of your EXTREMIS SENTINEL units picked to shoot can use Big Guns Never Tire as if its models were VEHICLE models. Use this when the unit is selected to shoot. Until the end of the phase, its models have that rule, and they also don't take the -1 penalty to hit rolls for attacking with Heavy weapons against units they are within Engagement Range of. It costs 3 CP if the unit has 4 or more models, and 2 CP otherwise.

4f259c74e10f.name: Circuitous Assassins
4f259c74e10f.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, pick one of your SICARIAN units that is wholly within 9" of any battlefield edge and take it off the battlefield. Then, during the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, you may put it back anywhere that is wholly within 9" of any battlefield edge and over 9" from every enemy model. A unit still off the battlefield when the battle ends is destroyed.

5209212d0ace.name: Galvanic Volley Fire
5209212d0ace.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your SKITARII RANGERS units is picked to shoot, the galvanic rifles its models carry count as Rapid Fire 2 weapons for the rest of that phase.

52e82b534d33.name: Data-blessed Autosermon
52e82b534d33.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units within 6" of a friendly TECH-PRIEST model, and pick one Canticle that your army hasn't had active yet. Until the start of your next Command phase, that unit treats that Canticle as active for your army, on top of the one that is currently active.

53f89f0ae87c.name: Dogma - Refusal To Yield
53f89f0ae87c.plain: Units with this dogma pass Combat Attrition tests automatically. If a model with this dogma would lose a wound to a mortal wound, roll one D6; on a 5+ it doesn't lose that wound.

55c814437f87.name: Stratagem: Omnissiah's Exaltation - 1 CP
55c814437f87.plain: In the Morale phase, subtract 1 from combat attrition tests for an enemy unit within 6" of one of your METALICA units. Use this when that enemy unit is selected to take a Morale test; the penalty lasts until the end of the phase.

56da20a9ed3f.name: Binharic Override
56da20a9ed3f.plain: Once per battle, at the start of any phase: pick one of your KASTELAN ROBOT units and one of the protocols available on its datasheet. That protocol takes the place of the unit's currently active protocol, and the unit's active protocol can't be changed for the rest of the game.

56f9957e23b9.name: Plasma Specialists
56f9957e23b9.plain: In your Shooting phase, when a RYZA unit is picked to shoot: for the rest of that phase, attacks its models make with plasma weapons have 1 added to their Damage characteristic.

57f6b04c4004.name: Dogma - Solar Blessing
57f6b04c4004.plain: Models with this dogma add 1 to armour saving throws against any attack allocated to them that has a Damage characteristic of 1. The ranged weapons they are equipped with also have 3" added to their Range characteristic.

582fe72c2b25.name: Enhanced Bionics
582fe72c2b25.plain: Before the battle begins, choose a SERVITOR MANIPLE KATAPHRON BREACHERS unit or a SERVITOR MANIPLE KATAPHRON DESTROYERS unit from your army. For the whole battle, it has a 5+ invulnerable save.

592bc73717d7.name: Eyes of the Omnissiah
592bc73717d7.plain: In your Command phase, this WARLORD lets one of your units re-roll its Advance rolls and charge rolls. That unit must be one of your <FORGE WORLD> SKITARII CORE units within 9" of this WARLORD, or one of your <FORGE WORLD> CORE DATA TETHER units anywhere on the battlefield. The re-rolls last until your next Command phase starts.

5a305312a9b8.name: Verse of Vengeance
5a305312a9b8.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your AGRIPINAA CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD; its models can strike back on a 4+ when enemy attacks destroy them. Until your next Command phase starts, each time an attack by an enemy model destroys a model in that unit, roll one D6. On a 4+, don't remove the destroyed model yet: once the attacking model's unit has finished all its attacks, the destroyed model can either fire one of its ranged weapons as though it were the Shooting phase, or make a single attack with one of its melee weapons as though it were the Fight phase. Once those attacks are resolved, remove the destroyed model.

5b4e17307e90.name: Purity of the Machine
5b4e17307e90.plain: Use this in your Shooting phase when a METALICA unit of yours is picked to shoot, or in the Fight phase when a METALICA unit of yours is picked to fight. For the rest of that phase, attacks by that unit's models may ignore any or all hit roll and wound roll modifiers. Cost: 2CP if the unit is a VEHICLE, otherwise 1CP.

5c1bb0b7b413.name: Deeply Sunk Talons
5c1bb0b7b413.plain: In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit (other than a VEHICLE unit) is selected to Fall Back: if it is within Engagement Range of any of your PTERAXII STERYLIZOR units, roll one D6. On a 2+, that enemy unit can't Fall Back until the end of the phase.

5c8bed9310d5.name: Wrath of Mars
5c8bed9310d5.plain: In your Shooting phase, when a MARS unit is picked to shoot: for the rest of that phase, every unmodified wound roll of 6 made for its models' attacks also inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target, in addition to normal damage, with no more than 6 mortal wounds in total this way. Cost: 2CP if the unit's Power Rating is 11 or higher, otherwise 1CP.

5c94de512d42.name: Maneuverable Craft
5c94de512d42.plain: Whenever this model makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, first turn it on the spot by up to 90° (this doesn't count toward the distance it moves), then move it straight forward. At any point during that move it can turn by up to 90° once more.

5d46c1b6617c.name: Dogma - Staunch Defenders
5d46c1b6617c.plain: Ranged attacks by models with this dogma against a target within half range have their Armour Penetration characteristic improved by 1. A unit with this dogma that is charged by an enemy unit can Hold Steady or Set To Defend, provided it is not in Engagement Range of any enemy units when the charge is declared.

5fbe8698140a.name: Mindless Servant
5fbe8698140a.plain: You can include X-101 in an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS Detachment and it won't prevent the other units in that Detachment from gaining a Forge World Dogma. X-101 itself can never benefit from a Forge World Dogma.

60c2c39d5b3a.name: Dataspike
60c2c39d5b3a.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS TECH-PRIEST models is picked to fight, choose one enemy VEHICLE unit within its Engagement Range and roll one D6: a 2 to 5 inflicts D3 mortal wounds on that unit, and a 6 inflicts D3+3 mortal wounds.

638a627b5af1.name: March to War
638a627b5af1.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your METALICA units Advances, don't make an Advance roll. Instead, add 6" to that unit's Move characteristic until the end of the phase. This doesn't stack with the Dunestriders Stratagem.

68d1ffac4a44.name: Citation of Ruin
68d1ffac4a44.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your EXTREMIS SENTINEL units is picked to shoot: for the rest of that phase, its models have the Big Guns Never Tire rule the same way VEHICLE models do. On top of that, when they attack with heavy weapons against units within their Engagement Range, they ignore the -1 hit roll penalty described in Big Guns Never Tire. Cost: 3CP if the unit has 4 or more models, otherwise 2CP.

68d219541bdc.name: Optimised Gait
68d219541bdc.plain: Any or all modifiers to this unit's Move characteristic can be ignored, except the one caused by the Bulwark Imperative's Deprecation effect. Any or all modifiers to its Advance and charge rolls can be ignored too.

69049f5d6d1b.name: Power Surge
69049f5d6d1b.plain: When your Charge phase starts, choose one CYBERNETICA COHORT KASTELAN ROBOTS unit of yours that is within 3" of a friendly CYBERNETICA COHORT CYBERNETICA DATASMITH. That unit adds 3 to its charge rolls for the rest of the phase.

6bce05ad923b.name: Aerial Deployment
6bce05ad923b.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, then for every ARCHAEOPTER TRANSVECTOR unit in a Detachment, you can add a second ARCHAEOPTER TRANSVECTOR unit to that Detachment without it using up another Battlefield Role slot.

6bdeb9c76366.name: Indentured Machines
6bdeb9c76366.plain: Before the battle, pick one of your AGRIPINAA KATAPHRON SERVITORS units. Models in that unit add 1 to their Toughness characteristic. Each unit can be picked for this Stratagem only once. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

6c3c2f8fb70f.name: Data-Bleed Generators
6c3c2f8fb70f.plain: Melee attacks against a unit with this dogma subtract 1 from the hit roll if the attacker charged, was charged or Heroically Intervened this turn. This applies to every melee attack by an enemy model that, this turn, made a charge move, was charged or made a Heroic Intervention.

6c6b44b84451.name: Phosphor Serpenta
6c6b44b84451.plain: Targets of attacks made with this weapon don't get the benefits of Dense Cover against those attacks.

6d55a6b2c3d5.name: Crushing Weight
6d55a6b2c3d5.plain: In your Charge phase, when one of your IRONSTRIDER ENGINE or KASTELAN ROBOTS units finishes a charge move: pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it. Roll one D6 for each model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of that enemy unit; each 2+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the enemy unit.

6e60ceadbf95.name: Secutarii
6e60ceadbf95.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, you can include this unit in an Adeptus Mechanicus Detachment and it won't stop the other units in that Detachment from getting a forge world dogma. This unit itself can never benefit from a forge world dogma.

72d372351390.name: Titan Guard
72d372351390.plain: While this model is within 6" of any of your <TITANIC LEGION> TITANIC models, it can perform Heroic Interventions as though it were a CHARACTER. This unit can perform a Heroic Intervention whenever any enemy unit is within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically of it, and when it does, it can move 6" rather than 3". All other Heroic Intervention rules still apply.

754d0eba13dd.name: Accelerated Actuators
754d0eba13dd.plain: When a unit with this dogma fights after charging, being charged or Heroically Intervening, its melee weapons' Armour Penetration is improved by 1. This applies each time the unit fights in a turn in which it made a charge move, was charged, or made a Heroic Intervention, and lasts until that fight is resolved.

77e9549b0987.name: Inspiring Leader
77e9549b0987.plain: Your units within 6" of this Warlord can increase their Leadership characteristic by 1.

792b3ca9bbe8.name: Dogma - Red in Cog and Claw
792b3ca9bbe8.plain: Melee attacks by a model with this dogma get 1 added to the wound roll if, this turn, the model made a charge move, was charged or made a Heroic Intervention. Charge rolls for units with this dogma also get 1 added.

7aa73a231aa9.name: Fanatical Devotion
7aa73a231aa9.plain: Whenever one of this unit's models loses a wound, roll one D6; if it is 5+, that wound isn't lost.

7b3f98fbd7d8.name: Darting Hunters
7b3f98fbd7d8.plain: Falling Back doesn't stop this unit from being eligible to charge that turn.

7b9c9b4ea20c.name: Cybernetica Cohort
7b9c9b4ea20c.plain: While choosing your army, choose one of its ADEPTUS MECHANICUS Detachments as a Cybernetica Cohort Specialist Detachment. Every unit in that Detachment that is one of the following gains the CYBERNETICA COHORT keyword: KASTELAN ROBOTS, CYBERNETICA DATASMITHS, ENGINSEERS, TECH-PRIESTS DOMINUS.

7d2f0df7932f.name: Servo-arc claw
7d2f0df7932f.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it can make no more than one attack with each Servo-arc claw. Attacks made with this weapon against a VEHICLE unit have a Damage characteristic of 4, and an unmodified wound roll of 4+ wounds the target successfully.

7e19e3ca5217.name: Servo-skull Uplink
7e19e3ca5217.plain: While one of your <FORGE WORLD> SKITARII CORE units is within 6" of this model, models in that unit re-roll wound rolls of 1 when making attacks.

7e2262375d6b.name: Blind Barrage
7e2262375d6b.plain: Once per battle, in the Shooting phase, this unit can fire a blind barrage instead of shooting. If it does, your opponent must subtract 1 from the hit roll of each ranged attack that targets this unit, until your next Shooting phase starts.

7e60a57a1441.name: Heavy Grav-Cannon
7e60a57a1441.plain: Attacks made with this weapon against a target whose Save characteristic is 3+ or better have a Damage characteristic of 2.

7f1fd85cc658.name: Bolster Defences
7f1fd85cc658.plain: Once per battle, before the battle and after deployment zones are determined: pick one Area Terrain or Obstacles feature in your deployment zone. It gains the Light Cover terrain trait. If it already had Light Cover, it adds 2 to saving throws rather than 1 (it still doesn't affect invulnerable saving throws).

7f45b127601b.name: Stealth Optimisation
7f45b127601b.plain: This unit gets the benefits of Light Cover against every ranged attack made against it. If it makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back in your Movement phase, it loses this ability until your next Movement phase starts.

816e580f4fd9.name: Stratagem: Bolster Defences - 2 CP
816e580f4fd9.plain: Before the battle, once deployment zones are set, one Area Terrain or Obstacle feature in your deployment zone gains the Light Cover terrain trait. Pick that terrain feature. If it already had the Light Cover terrain trait, the bonus it gives to saving throws is 2 instead of 1. You can use this Stratagem only once.

81db81ff0e51.name: Machine Sentience (Aura)
81db81ff0e51.plain: Aura: while one of your <FORGE WORLD> KASTELAN ROBOTS units is within 3" of this model, that unit has the CORE keyword.

8355e763ae0d.name: Hover Jet
8355e763ae0d.plain: Before this model moves in your Movement phase, you can declare that it will hover. If you do, its Movement characteristic is 20" until the end of that phase, and until the start of your next Movement phase it loses its Airborne, Hard to Hit and Maneuverable Craft abilities.

887cde80916b.name: Rad-bombardment
887cde80916b.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, if your MECHANICUS DEFENCE COHORT WARLORD is on the battlefield, place a marker on any point of the battlefield. When your next Command phase starts, roll one D6 per unit within 6" of the marker's centre (subtract 1 from the roll for a CHARACTER unit). A 4 or 5 inflicts D3 mortal wounds on that unit. A 6+ inflicts D3 mortal wounds on it and also gives each of its models 1 less Toughness until the turn ends (this does not stack with other rules that reduce an enemy model's Toughness characteristic). Afterwards, remove the marker.

88b50fc914db.name: Kastelan Phosphor Blaster
88b50fc914db.plain: When this weapon attacks, the target can't receive the benefits of Dense Cover against it.

89b52b78faa3.name: Siphoned Vigor
89b52b78faa3.plain: The first time this unit destroys an enemy unit, for the rest of the battle: add 1 to each roll for this unit's Voltagheist Blast ability, and this unit's models get a 4+ invulnerable save.

8a2f8c848ef3.name: Awaken the Machine
8a2f8c848ef3.plain: In your Command phase, this model can awaken one of your <FORGE WORLD> VEHICLE models within 3" of it (but not a KASTELAN ROBOT model). Until the start of your next Command phase, add 1 to the hit roll of each attack that model makes. A model can be awakened only once per turn.

8c8dbb4e24b4.name: Phosphor Blaster
8c8dbb4e24b4.plain: When this weapon attacks, the target gets no benefit from Dense Cover against that attack.

8c90e34d47ac.name: Tech-adept
8c90e34d47ac.plain: At the start of your Command phase or the start of your Movement phase, pick one ADEPTUS MECHANICUS TECH-PRIEST model in your army. In your Command phase, it can use its Machine Focus or Awaken the Machine ability one extra time that phase. In your Movement phase, it can use its Master of Machines ability one extra time that phase.

8da2099f0f5b.name: Battle Protocols: Conqueror
8da2099f0f5b.plain: While this protocol is active, you can re-roll charge rolls for this unit, and its models have a WS characteristic of 2+.

922e02beacf0.name: Panegyric Procession
922e02beacf0.plain: In your Command phase, you can give this WARLORD and one of your MARS CULT MECHANICUS CORE units within 6" of it a Canticle of your choice. If you pick a unit, also pick one Canticle; it may be one your army has already had active. Until your next Command phase starts, this WARLORD and that unit both benefit from the Canticle you picked instead of the one active for your army.

952a3642e1fd.name: Electroleech Stave
952a3642e1fd.plain: An unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon causes 2 mortal wounds to the target, and that attack's sequence then ends.

95b4085f384b.name: Machine Spirit Resurgent
95b4085f384b.plain: In your Command phase, choose one ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE model in your army. Until your next Command phase starts, that model counts as having all its wounds left when you check which characteristics on its profile apply.

95c664106682.name: Programmed Retreat
95c664106682.plain: In your Command phase, this WARLORD lets one of your units shoot after Falling Back. That unit must be one of your <FORGE WORLD> SKITARII CORE units within 9" of this WARLORD, or one of your <FORGE WORLD> CORE DATA TETHER units anywhere on the battlefield. Until your next Command phase starts, it can shoot even in a turn in which it Fell Back.

96e3ffe78ba3.name: Phosphor Blast Pistol
96e3ffe78ba3.plain: This weapon has the Blast ability. Targets of its attacks don't get the benefits of Dense Cover against those attacks.

989064913169.name: Voltagheist Blast
989064913169.plain: When this unit finishes a charge move, pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it. Roll one D6 for each of this unit's models within Engagement Range of that enemy unit; each 6+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on it.

9904f359baeb.name: Master of Machines
9904f359baeb.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, pick one of your <FORGE WORLD> models within 3"; this model can repair it, and it regains up to D3 lost wounds. A model can be repaired only once per turn.

993baf84b03c.name: Pre-calibrated Purge Solution
993baf84b03c.plain: In your Shooting phase, when an EXTREMIS SENTINEL unit of yours that is wholly within your deployment zone is picked to shoot: for the rest of that phase, its models add 1 to hit rolls for attacks against enemy units wholly within the enemy deployment zone.

9a3a711bd8bd.name: Doctrina Imperatives
9a3a711bd8bd.plain: This applies only if all units in your army have the ADEPTUS MECHANICUS keyword, not counting AGENT OF THE IMPERIUM, UNALIGNED and KNIGHT OF THE COG units. Then whichever Doctrina Imperative your army has active modifies this unit's characteristics. A Doctrina Imperative has two effects, and both apply to this unit while it is active: an Optimisation effect, which improves one characteristic of this unit, and a Deprecation effect, which worsens one. At the start of the battle round, if your army has a DOCTRINA ASSEMBLER model on the battlefield, you may choose a Doctrina Imperative your army has not yet had active; it is then active for your army until that battle round ends.

9bdff5770fd9.name: Assassin Constructs
9bdff5770fd9.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your SICARIAN units is picked to fight, check whether it made a charge move, was charged or made a Heroic Intervention this turn. If so, its models add 1 to their Attacks characteristic until that fight is resolved.

9d6eb8df8226.name: Machine Focus
9d6eb8df8226.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your units within 6" of this model that is <FORGE WORLD> CORE, <FORGE WORLD> SERVITORS or <FORGE WORLD> KATAPHRON SERVITORS. Until your next Command phase starts: if it has the KATAPHRON SERVITORS keyword, that unit can perform actions as though it had the INFANTRY keyword; and while that unit is performing an action, making ranged attacks doesn't cause that action to fail.

9e733717427e.name: Radioactive Emanation (Aura)
9e733717427e.plain: Aura: every unit within 6" of this WARLORD, except METALICA units, has its Toughness characteristic reduced by 1. This doesn't stack with any other rule that lowers an enemy model's Toughness characteristic.

9f5e2a6786df.name: Lead in Prayer
9f5e2a6786df.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your CULT MECHANICUS CORE units within 6" of this model. If you do, choose one Canticle (it may be one your army has already had active). This model and that unit then both use the chosen Canticle's benefit in place of your army's active Canticle until your next Command phase starts.

a0259c45d657.name: Purgation Protocols
a0259c45d657.plain: When a CORE model with this dogma makes a ranged attack, an unmodified wound roll of 6 improves that attack's Armour Penetration by 1.

a1de59216c72.name: Electro-shocked
a1de59216c72.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, pick one enemy unit (other than a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit) that is within Engagement Range of one of your CULT MECHANICUS CORE or CULT MECHANICUS CHARACTER units. Until the end of the phase, that enemy unit can't fight until every eligible unit from your army has fought.

a1f0896888a7.name: Arc Maul
a1f0896888a7.plain: When this weapon attacks a VEHICLE unit, the attack has Damage 2 and successfully wounds on any unmodified wound roll of 4+.

a31a5b1534f3.name: Control Edict
a31a5b1534f3.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick either one of your <FORGE WORLD> SKITARII units within 9" of this model, or one of your <FORGE WORLD> SKITARII DATA-TETHER units anywhere on the battlefield. Until your next Command phase starts, the Deprecation effect of the Doctrina Imperative currently active does not apply to that unit.

a54961545a4b.name: Rangers
a54961545a4b.plain: At the start of the first battle round, this unit's models can make a Normal Move of up to 3", but they can't end that move within 9" of enemy models.

a671f28e5601.name: Arc Claw
a671f28e5601.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it makes 1 extra attack with this weapon. Attacks made with this weapon against a VEHICLE unit have a Damage characteristic of 2, and an unmodified wound roll of 4+ wounds the target successfully.

a67bd31c6b48.name: Transonic cannon
a67bd31c6b48.plain: Attacks made with this weapon hit the target automatically. In addition, an unmodified wound roll of 6 with this weapon inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target as well as any normal damage.

a7d85a699c56.name: Electromancer’s Wrath
a7d85a699c56.plain: In your Shooting phase, choose one enemy unit within 12" of one of your ELECTRO-PRIESTS units; it can't be a VEHICLE unit. Roll one D6, and subtract 1 from the result if the target has the CHARACTER keyword. A 2 to 5 inflicts D3 mortal wounds on it; a 6 inflicts 2D3 mortal wounds.

a7f13caa4525.name: Master of Machines (Datasmith)
a7f13caa4525.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, pick one of your <FORGE WORLD> KASTELAN ROBOT models within 3" of this model; this model can repair it, and that KASTELAN ROBOT model then gets back up to D3 lost wounds. A model can be repaired only once per turn.

a9ea31891cfd.name: Autosavant Spirits
a9ea31891cfd.plain:
VEHICLE models with this dogma regain 1 lost wound in your Command phase, and models with this dogma count double wounds for damage-based characteristics.
- When your Command phase starts, each VEHICLE model with this dogma in your army regains 1 lost wound.
- If a model with this dogma has characteristics that change as it suffers damage, treat it as having twice its remaining wounds when working out what those characteristics are.

ab3f113b3378.name: Bomb Rack
ab3f113b3378.plain: Once per turn, after this model moves in your Movement phase, you can pick one unit it moved over. Roll six D6 for each VEHICLE or MONSTER model in that unit and one D6 for each other model in it, up to ten D6 in total. Each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on that unit. Rules update (January 2023): this only works if this model is still on the battlefield when its move ends.

abf82ab11072.name: Omnissiah's Exaltation
abf82ab11072.plain: In the Morale phase, if an enemy unit within 6" of a METALICA unit from your army is chosen to take a Morale test, Combat Attrition tests for that enemy unit have 1 subtracted from them for the rest of the phase.

ad53cbc49fa4.name: Forward Operations
ad53cbc49fa4.plain: When the first battle round starts, SKITARII CORE models with this dogma in your army can each make a Normal Move of up to 3". This is on top of any other abilities that let them make a Normal Move. None of them can end this move within 9" of enemy models.

ade8dfa2c38c.name: Canticles of the Omnissiah
ade8dfa2c38c.plain:
1. Shroudpsalm: while this canticle is active, this unit gets Light Cover benefits.
2. Chant of the Remorseless Fist: while it is active, add 1 to the Strength of each melee attack made by a model in this unit.
3. Incantation of the Iron Soul: while it is active, ignore any or all modifiers on Combat Attrition tests taken for this unit. Also, whenever a model in this unit would lose a wound to a mortal wound, roll one D6: on a 5+ the wound is not lost (on a 4+ instead if this unit has the Refusal to Yield Dogma).
4. Benediction of the Omnissiah: while it is active, whenever a unit is chosen to shoot, you can re-roll one hit roll, re-roll one wound roll and re-roll one damage roll when resolving its attacks.
5. Invocation of Machine Vengeance: while it is active, whenever an Advance or Charge roll is made for this unit, roll one extra D6 and discard the lowest one.
6. Litany of the Electromancer: while it is active, subtract 1 from the hit roll of each melee attack made against this unit.

afe7e3494aba.name: Radium Jezzail
afe7e3494aba.plain: When picking this weapon's target, the Look Out, Sir rule can be ignored. An unmodified hit roll of 6 with this weapon automatically wounds the target, as long as the target is an enemy unit that is not a VEHICLE unit.

b01073387e54.name: Brotherhood of the Cog
b01073387e54.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, each TECH-PRIEST DOMINUS or TECH-PRIEST MANIPULUS unit in a Detachment lets you include one TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER or TECHNOARCHEOLOGIST unit in that same Detachment without it using up an additional Battlefield Role slot.

b3d38b00b59a.name: Purified Datasphere
b3d38b00b59a.plain: Units with this dogma have 3" more range on their aura abilities other than Rad-saturation, to a maximum of 9".

b47c159a151a.name: Reprogramming
b47c159a151a.plain: This model can attempt the Field Reprogramming action. Any number of CYBERNETICA DATASMITH models in your army can start this action at the end of your Movement phase. When it starts, pick one of your <FORGE WORLD> KASTELAN ROBOTS units within 6" of the model performing it, and pick one of the protocols available on that unit's datasheet. The action is completed when your next Command phase ends, and when it is, the chosen protocol replaces that unit's active protocol.

b55b9b853e95.name: Servitor Maniple
b55b9b853e95.plain: While choosing your army, choose one of its ADEPTUS MECHANICUS Detachments as a Servitor Maniple Specialist Detachment. Every unit in that Detachment that is one of the following gains the SERVITOR MANIPLE keyword: SERVITORS, KATAPHRON DESTROYERS, KATAPHRON BREACHERS, ENGINSEERS, TECH-PRIESTS DOMINUS.

b576a974d54f.name: Overloaded Systems
b576a974d54f.plain: Use in any phase, after an arc weapon attack by an ADEPTUS MECHANICUS model in your army causes an enemy VEHICLE model to lose one or more wounds. If that VEHICLE model has characteristics that can change as it is damaged, roll one D6. On a 2+, until your next Command phase starts, that VEHICLE counts as having half its wounds remaining for working out those characteristics. Cost: 2CP if that enemy model has the TITANIC keyword, otherwise 1CP.

b6b37f8ebba6.name: Belleros Energy Cannon
b6b37f8ebba6.plain: This weapon has the Blast ability, and it can target units the bearer can't see.

b84cf55ae3e9.name: Dogma - Shroud Protocolls
b84cf55ae3e9.plain: When a ranged attack targets a VEHICLE unit with this dogma that doesn't have the CORE keyword, the target gets the benefits of Dense Cover against it if the attacker is more than 18" away. When a ranged attack targets any other unit with this dogma (anything except VEHICLE units lacking the CORE keyword), the target gets the benefits of Dense Cover against it if the attacker is more than 12" away. When a unit with this dogma declares a charge, none of the units it is charging can Hold Steady or Set to Defend.

ba92321ab137.name: Seismic Bomb
ba92321ab137.plain: When an ARCHAEOPTER FUSILAVE model finishes a move during your Movement phase, choose one enemy unit that it passed over this phase; TITANIC units and units that can FLY can't be chosen. That unit is shaken until your next Movement phase starts. A shaken unit's models have their Move characteristic halved, and its Advance rolls and charge rolls are halved.

bb80292dba88.name: Stratagem: Aggression Override -1 CP
bb80292dba88.plain: In the Fight phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of models in one of your SKITARII VETERAN COHORT units that made a charge move this turn. This lasts until the end of the phase. This is a Battle Tactic Stratagem.

bc534502d17f.name: First-Hand Field Testing
bc534502d17f.plain: Pick one weapon this WARLORD is equipped with (not a Relic) when you choose this Warlord Trait; add 1 to that weapon's Strength and Damage.

c0847ad4fa90.name: Dogma - Masters of the Forge
c0847ad4fa90.plain: In this Detachment, SKITARII units have the Canticles of the Omnissiah ability. When a unit with this dogma is picked to shoot or fight, you may re-roll a single one of its hit rolls for those attacks.

c44f365ff404.name: Master Annihilator
c44f365ff404.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your METALICA units within 6" of this WARLORD to give its radium weapons 6" more range and 1 more Strength. This lasts until your next Command phase starts and covers every radium weapon its models are equipped with. A radium weapon here means any weapon with the word 'Radium' in its profile, plus any relic that replaces such a weapon. This rule doesn't stack with any other rule that increases the weapon's range.

c52e0ac4f0ae.name: Salvage Protocols
c52e0ac4f0ae.plain: When X-101 makes an attack that targets a VEHICLE, add 1 to its hit roll.

c56557d8da5d.name: Archived Engagements
c56557d8da5d.plain: In your Command phase, this WARLORD lets one of your units fight first if it starts the Fight phase within Engagement Range of enemy units. That unit must be one of your <FORGE WORLD> SKITARII CORE units within 9" of this WARLORD, or one of your <FORGE WORLD> CORE DATA TETHER units anywhere on the battlefield. Until your next Command phase starts, whenever the Fight phase begins with that unit within Engagement Range of any enemy units, it can fight first in that phase.

c6e4b758a29d.name: Enriched Rounds
c6e4b758a29d.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS units is selected to shoot: until the end of the phase, when a model in that unit attacks an enemy unit (other than a VEHICLE unit) with a radium weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 4+ wounds the target automatically.

c84430f771a6.name: Transonic Razor
c84430f771a6.plain: An unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target on top of any normal damage.

ca24bed97e53.name: Acquisitive Reach
ca24bed97e53.plain: The rifle and carbine weapons carried by models with this dogma have their Range characteristic increased by 6".

ca8c02a708a7.name: Solar Atomiser
ca8c02a708a7.plain: This weapon has the Blast ability. Attacks made with it against a unit within half range have a Damage characteristic of D3+3.

cb916a56554b.name: Dogma - Relentless March
cb916a56554b.plain: Models with this dogma ignore the hit roll penalty for firing Assault weapons in a turn their unit Advanced, and the hit roll penalty for firing Heavy weapons in a turn their unit moved. While an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of one of your units with this dogma, that enemy unit counts as being below Half-strength.

cc601ea71396.name: Mechanicus Locum
cc601ea71396.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the ADEPTUS MECHANICUS keyword: pick one ADEPTUS MECHANICUS CHARACTER model in your army and give it one Warlord Trait (chosen or rolled) that it is allowed to have. That model counts as your WARLORD only for that Warlord Trait. All Warlord Traits in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if you roll them randomly), and this Stratagem can't give one model two Warlord Traits. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

ce46f808ff3f.name: Smoke launchers
ce46f808ff3f.plain: The model with this gains the SMOKESCREEN keyword.

cf47ea72ba1d.name: Master of Machines
cf47ea72ba1d.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, pick one other friendly ADPEPTUS MECHANICUS or IMPERIUM VEHICLE model that is within 3" of this model; this model can repair it, and it regains up to D3 lost wounds. A model can be repaired only once per turn.

d37e4b3ddde2.name: Chaff Launcher
d37e4b3ddde2.plain: Whenever an attack is allocated to the model with this, reduce that attack's Damage characteristic by 1 (it can't go below 1).

d4b4b81e199d.name: Voices In The Code (Aura)
d4b4b81e199d.plain: Aura: while an enemy unit is within 3" of this unit, its models get 1 subtracted from their Leadership characteristic.

d63f9e415951.name: Archeotech Modifications
d63f9e415951.plain: Once per battle, when you use an Adeptus Mechanicus Wargear Stratagem while this model is on the battlefield, that Stratagem costs 1 CP less. The discount applies only to that single use; any later use of the Stratagem costs its usual CP.

d65841bd0627.name: Aggressive Subroutines
d65841bd0627.plain: Once per battle, when you use an Adeptus Mechanicus Epic Deed Stratagem while this model is on the battlefield, that Stratagem costs 1 CP less. The discount applies only to that single use; any later use of the Stratagem costs its usual CP.

d72b0610bfbd.name: Multitasking Cortex
d72b0610bfbd.plain: In your Command phase, this WARLORD lets one of your units make ranged attacks while performing an action without the action failing. That unit must be one of your <FORGE WORLD> SKITARII CORE units within 9" of this WARLORD, or one of your <FORGE WORLD> CORE DATA TETHER units anywhere on the battlefield. The effect lasts until your next Command phase starts: if the unit is performing an action, it can make ranged attacks and the action does not fail.

d8751f71a4f8.name: Heavy Arc Rifle
d8751f71a4f8.plain: When this weapon attacks a VEHICLE unit, the attack has Damage 3 and always successfully wounds on any unmodified wound roll of 4+.

d98192e625f1.name: Pistoleers
d98192e625f1.plain: Each time this unit Advances, the Pistol weapons its models are equipped with change their Type to Assault until the end of the turn. Models in this unit are still eligible to shoot with their Assault weapons in a turn in which they shot with Pistol weapons.

da61e883f618.name: Calculate Without Diversion

de5e55bb0bbd.name: Machine Spirit’s Revenge
de5e55bb0bbd.plain: In any phase, when one of your ADEPTUS MECHANICUS VEHICLE models is destroyed, it explodes automatically, with no roll needed.

de76352307cb.name: Deafening Assault
de76352307cb.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your METALICA units is selected to shoot, pick one enemy unit (not a VEHICLE unit) within 12" of it. Until the start of your next turn, models in that enemy unit have their Move characteristic halved, and the unit can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend.

deebc60765f2.name: Arc Rifle
deebc60765f2.plain: When this weapon attacks a VEHICLE unit, the attack has Damage 3 and successfully wounds on any unmodified wound roll of 4+.

e006402d616a.name: Field Reprogramming (Action)
e006402d616a.plain: Any number of CYBERNETICA DATASMITH models in your army can start this action at the end of your Movement phase. When it starts, pick one of your <FORGE WORLD> KASTELAN ROBOTS units within 6" of the model performing it, and pick one of the protocols available on that unit's datasheet. The action is completed when your next Command phase ends, and when it is, the chosen protocol replaces that unit's active protocol.

e1551c868a32.name: Scriptural Prognosis
e1551c868a32.plain: Once per battle, when you use an Adeptus Mechanicus Strategic Ploy Stratagem while this model is on the battlefield, that Stratagem costs 1 CP less. The discount applies only to that single use; any later use of the Stratagem costs its usual CP.

e274f8c425ad.name: Necromechanic
e274f8c425ad.plain: Whenever this WARLORD repairs a model with its Master of the Machines ability, that model gets back up to 3 lost wounds, not D3.

e2baf13ce6cf.name: Tenacious Survivor
e2baf13ce6cf.plain: Each time this Warlord loses a wound, roll a dice; on a 6, it ignores the damage and keeps that wound.

e4794f99586f.name: Thermal Riders
e4794f99586f.plain: During deployment, you can place this unit high in the skies rather than on the battlefield. If you do, you can set it up in the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases, anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from enemy units.

e7d9c7ffdafe.name: Battle Protocols
e7d9c7ffdafe.plain: This unit gets a bonus based on which protocol is active for it. When the battle starts, its active protocol is the Aegis Protocol. The Cybernetica Datasmith datasheet explains how to change the active protocol.

e81aa8394b73.name: Elimination Volley
e81aa8394b73.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your KATAPHRON SERVITORS units is selected to shoot: until the end of the phase, when a model in that unit attacks a unit within half range, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically.

eadf304aae0c.name: Galvanic Field
eadf304aae0c.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <FORGE WORLD> CORE units within 9" of this model that hasn't been picked for this ability yet this turn. Until your next Command phase starts, the Galvanic, Arc and Radium weapons (other than grenade weapons) that models in that unit are equipped with get 6" added to their range, and attacks made with those weapons have their Armour Penetration characteristic improved by 1.

ecff670e041f.name: Omnispex
ecff670e041f.plain: Ranged attacks made by models in the bearer's unit ignore the target's Light Cover benefits.

ed9d826f0650.name: Skirmish Optimisation
ed9d826f0650.plain: When an Advance roll is made for this unit, roll one extra D6 and discard one of the dice. When this unit is targeted by a Blast weapon, it never counts as having 6 or more models for working out how many attacks that weapon makes.

edfdda1e253e.name: Scarifying Weaponry
edfdda1e253e.plain: Radium weapons carried by models with this dogma have 1 added to their Strength characteristic and their Armour Penetration characteristic improved by 1.

f2f262bac677.name: Emotionless Clarity
f2f262bac677.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <FORGE WORLD> CULT MECHANICUS CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD to let it charge after Falling Back. Until your next Command phase starts, that unit can declare a charge even in a turn in which it Fell Back.

f56fd5eb6575.name: Citation In Savagery
f56fd5eb6575.plain: At the start of your Fight phase, pick one of your RYZA CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD to improve its melee attacks' Armour Penetration by 1. This lasts until the start of the next Fight phase and applies to each melee attack made by a model in that unit.

f5ebcd9be22e.name: Archeotech Specialists
f5ebcd9be22e.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the ADEPTUS MECHANICUS keyword: pick one ADEPTUS MECHANICUS CHARACTER model in your army and give it one Relic that it is allowed to have. All Relics in your army must be different, and this Stratagem can't give one model two Relics. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

f6eba40ff997.name: Stratagem: Binaric Offensive - 3 CP
f6eba40ff997.plain: In the Shooting phase, two of your SKITARII VETERAN COHORT CORE units add 1 to their ranged wound rolls, but can only target one chosen enemy unit. Pick one enemy unit and the two units. For the rest of the phase, models in those two SKITARII units can target only that enemy unit, and only if it is an eligible target for their attacks. Each ranged attack made by a model in either of them adds 1 to its wound roll. This is a Battle Tactic Stratagem.

f71360c1fe2c.name: Eye of Serberys
f71360c1fe2c.plain: The Look Out, Sir rule can be ignored when you pick targets for weapons that this unit's models attack with. In addition, ranged attacks made by this unit's models inflict 1 mortal wound on a wound roll of 6+, on top of any normal damage.

f749398ef204.name: Zealous Congregation
f749398ef204.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your ELECTRO-PRIESTS units is selected to fight: until the end of the phase, an unmodified hit roll of 6 for any attack by a model in that unit wounds the target automatically.

f8ff0399a4bb.name: Aggression Override
f8ff0399a4bb.plain: In the Fight phase, pick one of your SKITARII VETERAN COHORT units that made a charge move this turn. Until the end of the phase, models in that unit add 1 to their Attacks characteristic.

f9fc59e6c7e3.name: Binharic Offense
f9fc59e6c7e3.plain: In the Shooting phase, choose one enemy unit plus two SKITARII VETERAN COHORT CORE units from your army. For the rest of the phase, those two SKITARII units may target only that enemy unit, and only when it is an eligible target for their attacks. Whenever a model in either of them makes a ranged attack, add 1 to its wound roll.

fac030662ba6.name: Repulsor Grid
fac030662ba6.plain: Against ranged attacks, models in this unit have a 5+ invulnerable save. When you roll an unmodified 6 on an invulnerable saving throw for one of this unit's models against a ranged attack, the attacking model's unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

fd918e69331d.name: Radium Serpenta
fd918e69331d.plain: An unmodified hit roll of 6 with this weapon automatically wounds the target, as long as the target is an enemy unit that is not a VEHICLE unit.

fd96db7afb39.name: Command Uplink
fd96db7afb39.plain: The model with this gains the DATA-TETHER keyword and this ability: 'Command Uplink (Aura): while one of your <FORGE WORLD> SKITARII CORE units is within 3" of this model, models in that unit get 1 added to their Leadership characteristic, and the unit gains the DATA-TETHER keyword.'

fe3f4205d8c6.name: Artefactotum
fe3f4205d8c6.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army: pick one SKITARII model in your army that has 'Alpha' or 'Princeps' in its profile, and give it one of these Arcana Mechanicum, which must be a Relic it could have: The Cage of Varadimas, Temporcopia, The Omniscient Mask or The Skull of Elder Nikola. All Relics in your army must be different, and this Stratagem can't give one model two Relics. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

feff9ada6e47.name: Tracked Mobility
feff9ada6e47.plain: When moving, this unit's models pass freely through walls, girders, foliage and terrain features that have the Breachable terrain trait.

ffdbbf260d2f.name: Dunestriders
ffdbbf260d2f.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your IRONSTRIDER ENGINE or SERBERYS units is selected to Advance, the following apply until the end of the turn. Whenever that unit Advances, don't make an Advance roll; instead, models in it add 6" to their Move characteristic until the end of that phase. Heavy weapons carried by models in the unit have their Type changed to Assault. Models in the unit ignore the hit roll penalty for firing Assault weapons in a turn their unit Advanced.
